Profile Summary
Administrative and Document Control professional with 11 years of experience, including 9 years as an Administrative Executive and 2 years as a Document Controller. Proven expertise in managing administrative operations, document control processes, coordination, and implementing tasks in alignment with organizational vision, policies, and objectives. Strong track record of delivering accurate, timely, and high-quality work while supporting operational efficiency, promoting organizational services, and contributing to overall business success. Recognized for strong organizational, coordination, communication, and problem-solving skills with a commitment to maintaining professional standards and achieving business goals.



Career Objective
Looking forward to an organization that offers a challenging, stimulating, learning environment to work in and provide scope for individual development which offers attractive prospect for long term personal development and career growth.



Skill Highlights

· 	Administration
· 	MS Software
· 	Aconex (Software)
· 	Procure (Software)
· 	Documentation
	



Education

· 	Bachelor of Engineering – MSC Software - 2012
MSE Software Engineering from M Kumaraswamy college of engineering and technology

· 	12th Class – State Government of Tamil Nadu - 2007


Work Experience

· 	L & W Construction Pvt Ltd - Document Controller from 19th Jan 2023 to 3rd April 2024. (Mumbai)

· 	Innovative interiors Pvt Ltd - HR & Admin executive from Jan 2015 to December 2022. (Chennai)


  Roles and Responsibilities as a Document controller:

· 	Managed the complete lifecycle of project documents, including preparation, receipt, registration, distribution, revision, and archiving.
· 	Maintained and controlled incoming and outgoing document registers for all project-related correspondence and technical documents.
· 	Controlled drawings, specifications, method statements, ITPs, material submittals, RFIs, inspection requests, reports, and other technical documents.
· 	Ensured all documents were issued with the correct revision number, document number, status, and approval status.
· 	Coordinated with Project Managers, Engineers, QA/QC, Consultants, Contractors, and Clients for timely submission and approval of documents.
· 	Prepared and maintained Document Transmittals (DT) for submission and distribution of project documents.
· 	Maintained proper electronic and hard-copy filing systems for easy retrieval and audit purposes.
· 	Prepared daily, weekly, and monthly document status reports for project management.
· 	Tracked overdue documents and approvals and escalated critical delays to the concerned team.
· 	Supported internal and external audits by retrieving and providing required project records and supporting documents.
· 	Controlled confidential and sensitive project information in accordance with document access and distribution requirements.
· 	Maintained accurate records of document revisions, comments, approvals, and distribution history.

Roles and responsibilities as HR & Admin Executive

· 	Managed day-to-day HR and administrative activities to ensure smooth functioning of the organization.
· 	Maintained employee personal files, joining documents, attendance records, leave records, and HR documentation.
· 	Coordinated the employee joining and onboarding process, including documentation, induction, and orientation.
· 	Monitored employee attendance, leave, shift schedules, and working hours.
· 	Coordinated with payroll teams for monthly salary processing, attendance inputs, deductions, and employee-related changes.
· 	Assisted in recruitment and manpower planning, including job postings, candidate screening, interview coordination, and joining formalities.
· 	Prepared HR-related letters such as appointment letters, confirmation letters, experience letters, relieving letters, transfer letters, and salary certificates.
· 	Coordinated with employees regarding HR policies, company procedures, attendance, leave, salary, and other administrative matters.
· 	Handled general office administration, including stationery, office supplies, housekeeping, security, transportation, and facility-related requirements.
· 	Coordinated with vendors, contractors, service providers, and external agencies for administrative requirements.
· 	Maintained records of office assets, equipment, stationery, and other company resources.
· 	Coordinated travel arrangements, accommodation, transportation, meetings, and official events for employees and management.
· 	Assisted in ensuring compliance with applicable company policies and statutory HR requirements.
· 	Monitored and followed up on pending HR and administrative activities to ensure timely completion.
· 	Prepared HR and administrative reports using MS Excel and MS Office.

Personal Information

	Date of Birth	: 30/08/1990
	Marital Status	: Married
	Nationality	: Indian


Declaration
· 	


I hereby declare that all the above-mentioned information in this resume is in accordance with facts and truth to my knowledge. I take full responsibility for the correctness of the said information.





 Thanks & Regards

			Place	: 	MUMBAI	

				Date	: 		(Vijayalakshmi B)
